// Every route to the host's home directory in a test file: HOME off
// process.env and homedir off the os module. A line ending in "// flagged"
// must be reported; every other line must pass.
import { homedir } from 'node:os'; // flagged
import { homedir as getHome } from 'node:os'; // flagged
import { tmpdir, homedir as hostHome } from 'os'; // flagged
import * as os from 'node:os';
import osDefault from 'os';
export { homedir as reexportedHome } from 'node:os'; // flagged
export * from 'os'; // flagged
os.homedir(); // flagged
osDefault.homedir(); // flagged
const readLater = os.homedir; // flagged
osDefault['homedir'](); // flagged
os[`homedir`](); // flagged
const { homedir: fromRequire } = require('os'); // flagged
const { homedir: fromNodeRequire } = require('node:os'); // flagged
const requiredOs = require('node:os');
requiredOs.homedir(); // flagged
require('node:os').homedir(); // flagged
require('os')['homedir'](); // flagged
const { homedir: fromNamespace } = os; // flagged
const { 'homedir': quotedKey } = osDefault; // flagged
const { homedir: fromDynamic } = await import('node:os'); // flagged
(await import('os')).homedir(); // flagged
process.env.HOME; // flagged
process.env['HOME']; // flagged
process['env'].HOME; // flagged
const { HOME } = process.env; // flagged
const { HOME: bracketHome } = process['env']; // flagged
const { env: { HOME: nestedHome } } = process; // flagged
({ HOME: assignedHome } = process.env); // flagged
os.tmpdir();
tmpdir();
process.env.PATH;
// Fixture data that only shares the names passes.
const childEnv = { HOME: 'fixture-home' };
const fixtureEnv = { HOME: 'fixture-home' };
fixtureEnv.HOME;
fixtureEnv['HOME'];
const { HOME: fixtureHome } = fixtureEnv;
const fixtureOs = { homedir: () => 'fixture-home' };
fixtureOs.homedir();
const { homedir: fixtureHomedir } = fixtureOs;
const readEnv = (process) => process.env.HOME;
// An alias of process.env or of an os binding is written from it, so it may
// be the source.
const env = process.env;
env.HOME; // flagged
const osAlias = os;
osAlias.homedir(); // flagged
// Residuals: a computed name, Reflect.get and a value passed through a call
// are out of a syntactic rule's reach.
os['home' + 'dir']();
Reflect.get(os, 'homedir');
const passEnv = (value) => value;
passEnv(process.env).HOME;
